includes: Boat rental includes We-no-nah and Old Town canoes, Jackson kayaks, and Tributary rafts
blurb: Guests can rent canoes, kayaks, and rafts to float the Buffalo National River. Shuttle services are available to transport vehicles between put-in and take-out points. Cabins are available near the river, fully equipped with kitchen appliances and basic linens.
extraNote: Cancellations more than 21 days before reservation are fully refundable minus $40 fee · Cancellations within 21 days are non-refundable but qualify for reschedule until October 31 · Trip insurance available for 9% of reservation total, allows cancellation up to 24 hours before departure with full refund minus insurance cost · Floats proceed rain or shine with no refunds for early take-outs · If river is at flood or too low to float, free reschedule or full refund available until October 31 · Boat retrieval fee is $175
